name: opentia-toolkit
description: Claude Desktop extension for Siemens TIA Portal automation with OpenTiaToolkit.
long_description: Provides the OpenTiaToolkit local MCP server for Claude Desktop. The server runs on the user's Windows machine and exposes TIA Portal, PLC, and Unified HMI automation tools over stdio.

tools.name: connect-portal
tools.description: Connect to a running TIA Portal instance or start a new one.

tools.name: open-project
tools.description: Open a TIA Portal project file.

tools.name: open-unified-hmi
tools.description: Open a Unified HMI by device or device item name.

tools.name: get-hmi-screen-json
tools.description: Read one Unified HMI screen as canonical JSON for agent editing.

tools.name: apply-hmi-screen-json-patch
tools.description: Dry-run or apply compact Unified HMI screen patch operations with safety checks.
